_doc: The dev-tool registry (docs/DEVTOOLS_DESIGN.md 2.2; user guide docs/DEVTOOLS.md).
One row per tool of the CLOSED set in kernel/devtools.cpp kTools[] - scripts/audit_forcing.py
fails when the two differ (name and class). class: observe = display / read-only (never writes
guest memory, never calls guest code); devtool = acts on the game (the run is tagged
dev-tool-assisted). gate: how it is switched on (always default OFF). protocol: the per-step
4 triangulate, 5 oracle, 6 observe-only and cheap) - HONEST: a step is 'done' only with the
evidence named in it. A tool's number is quoted as evidence only when every applicable step is done.

tools.name: objstate
tools.gate: devToolAllowed("objstate") via dev.txt / SR_DEVTOOLS (default OFF); hook devToolHookNeeded_sub_8223EB08/ECC0/F230
guest_reads: base flow + DAS (objectiveStatus0..8, objectiveFound0..8, objective*, triggersAvailable, waitingForLoad, ...)
OBJ|TRIGGERS members and their trigger FSM states
BaseWorldFlow FSM state id (proved against the baseworl.AST graph)
tools.truth_source: kernel/devtools_skip_core.cpp = the C++ port of tools/devtools/skipexec.py (objstate.py's ports); [OBJSTATE] lines every SR_DEVTOOLS_OBJSTATE_EVERY active ticks when the story key changes, plus <SR_DEVTOOLS_OUT>/objstate_<n>.{snap,report.json}

protocol.1: done offline: report == skipexec.report on 3 goldens + 5 live-run-1 snaps (tools/devtools/test_skipcore_cpp.py)
protocol.4: inherits objstate.py's availability / metro / FSM-distance triangulation
protocol.5: open: no in-exe dump compared with the Xenia oracle yet
protocol.6: reads only on the tick thread, fault-free (hostRangeReadableCached); cost unmeasured

known_differences: a dump is the C++ report (skipexec.report keys), not the full objstate snapshot; the .snap it writes holds only the pages that report read, so objstate.py over it fails the checks that need more pages

tools.name: freecam
tools.gate: devToolAllowed("freecam") via dev.txt / SR_DEVTOOLS (default OFF); commands `freecam on|off` (devToolsSubmit / F6 / a plan step); hook devToolHookNeeded_sub_8223EB08
guest_reads: camera manager *0x8296D86C: owner mode +0x10, selector +0x1310, state +0x1320, pending +0x1328/+0x132C, the debug camera's vtables at +0x1150/+0x1154
input context manager *0x8296D884: slot array +0x20, slot count +0x1C
guest_writes: on: camera manager +0x132C := 0.0, +0x1328 := 10, +0x10 := 1; controller slot 1 input context (*(*0x8296D884+0x20)+0x1C) := 7 (DebugContext)
off: camera manager +0x10 := 0 (when 0 or 1); slot 1 context restored when still 7
guest_calls: off: SetInterfaceState_sub_821745D0(mgr, saved, 1), a pending SetInterfaceState(mgr, p, 0) / RequestInterfaceState_sub_8218CD68, SlotSwitch_SetMode_sub_821E8588(*0x8296DF4C, 1)
tools.truth_source: the retail debug camera itself (CameraManagerCtor_sub_8218C4C0 +0x1150; fly controls CameraInputKeyHandler_sub_821691A8); the switch is the dev's (0x821A99A0 -> 0x8219B2C8 / 0x821A8078), ported in kernel/devtools_levelskip.cpp; host input routed to guest controller 2 (kernel/stubs.cpp)

protocol.1: C1 (write list = the switch's enable/disable stores, docs/DEVTOOLS.md 6.4); no machine differential
protocol.3: the camera manager / input-context functions are exact matcher twins (CameraManagerCtor, CameraInputKeyHandler, IgcContextManagerInitSlots, SetInterfaceState, RequestInterfaceState)
protocol.5: open: the Frida executor cannot make Xenia guest calls (refuses 'unsupported')
protocol.6: gate off = exact pass-through (zero-impact replays); writes and calls only on the tick thread at the drain point

tools.calibration_test: live roll: freecam on/off from a plan; frames + [DEVTOOL] act=freecam lines; camera manager state read back
known_differences: the camera wants a second pad; ours routes the host pad + keyboard to guest controller 2 and reports controller 1 neutral while it is on
freecam off also restores controller 2's input context
a pending state request with a transition time is applied with RequestInterfaceState(f1 = its time, r5 = 0, r6 = 0)

tools.name: cheats
tools.gate: devToolAllowed("cheats") via dev.txt / SR_DEVTOOLS (default OFF); commands through devToolsSubmit (the in-game Dev Tools menu) or a plan (then under levelskip); hook devToolHookNeeded_sub_8223EB08
guest_reads: warp: the pad-0 actor's class vt (0x82009798) and vt+0xC, its position +0x20; warp camera: the debug camera *0x8296D86C +0x1150 +0x70
infinite_stamina: the upgrade registry *0x8296DF6C, the Superman actor +0x68, the StaminaInfinite entry +0x23
guest_writes: pause_timers on|off: byte +37 (running) of every running flow-owned timer node (the store of sub_82209270 / ScriptCmd_PauseTimer); off restores exactly the nodes on paused
metro_lock on|off: health := max, fraction := 1.0, damage-enabled +0x2C := 0 (= the stores of retail INFINITE_METROPOLIS minus its lock byte); off restores the damage byte
infinite_stamina on|off (command channel; F8): StaminaInfinite upgrade +0x23 owned := 1|0 (the retail INFINITE_STAMINA cheat's store, without the cheat's active flag and cheat-used byte)
guest_calls: warp X Y Z | warp camera (command channel only; F7 = warp camera): GameInput_GetPadActor_sub_8229E210(*0x8296E8C8, 0), then the Superman actor's vt+0xC sub_821AA218(actor, &(X, Y, Z, 0)); its stores (actor +0x20, the physics proxy body) are the game's own

infinite_stamina on|off: GameInput_GetPadActor_sub_8229E210, FindEntryByName_sub_821F0CB8(*0x8296DF6C, "StaminaInfinite" 0x82009E6C), then ApplyPowerups_sub_8221F808(*0x8296DF6C) = the retail cheat's own call (C1: tools/devtools/c1_cheats.py)
